name: Mosaic Research Management
description: New York-based expert network and primary research firm providing custom expert recruiting for institutional investors and management consultancies.
keyDifferentiators: Mosaic says it conducts custom searches for each engagement
overview:
Mosaic Research Management is a New York-based expert network and primary research firm founded in 2010. It provides custom recruiting for institutional investors and management consultancies. Its FAQ describes telephone consultations with experts across industries and geographies.

Mosaic says its process covers sourcing, phone and email vetting, scheduling, and expert payment. Its advertised engagement types include deep-dive research projects, named targeted recruits, and semi-exclusive panels for monitoring investments.

history.narrative: Mosaic dates its founding to June 2010. AlphaSense announced its acquisition of Stream by Mosaic on October 25, 2021; that announcement says Mosaic created Stream in 2020.

timeline.event: Founded in June, according to Mosaic.
Created Stream, according to the subsequent AlphaSense acquisition announcement.
AlphaSense announced its acquisition of Stream by Mosaic on October 25.

Mosaic dates its current Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to August 2026; they describe confidentiality requirements, compliance screening, consultation records, and opt-in SMS scheduling communications.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: Mosaic describes telephone engagements between experts and institutional investors or management consultancies. Its Advisors page and FAQ introduction describe 30–60-minute engagements; the FAQ’s time-commitment answer gives 45–60 minutes for normal calls.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Expert Recruiting
servicesDetailed.description: Mosaic says it sources and vets experts for individual projects, including specifically named recruits.

servicesDetailed.name: Research Panels
servicesDetailed.description: Mosaic advertises deep-dive projects spanning a value chain and semi-exclusive expert panels for monitoring positions.

complianceExtended.narrative: Mosaic’s August 2026 terms prohibit experts from disclosing material non-public information, trade secrets, or information subject to confidentiality duties. Experts must comply with screening and decline questions that would breach their obligations.
highlights: Mosaic says it screens experts by phone and email for relevance and compliance
Its privacy policy says it collects compliance-screener responses and consultation records

clientFit.narrative: Mosaic identifies institutional investors and management consultancies as clients. Editorial assessment: its advertised custom searches and panels suit buyers seeking project-specific recruiting or ongoing monitoring.

strengths: Offers named targeted recruits and semi-exclusive panels
caveats: Expert-pool size and employee count were not verified in this review.
The reviewed pages do not substantiate AI matching, automated MNPI screening, or a client-facing audit trail.
The FAQ describes expert compensation, but does not establish buyer pricing.
Beyond the August 2026 policy dates, no material developments from 2025-11-11 through 2026-11-11 were found in the sources reviewed.
notableFacts: AlphaSense acquired Stream by Mosaic in 2021.
Mosaic’s current privacy policy and terms are dated August 2026.
